summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of incorrect indentation when using the prepend option in the literalinclude directive. It does so by adding the same leading whitespace to the prepend string as the first line of the included code.

issues.description: The patch assumes that the first line of the included code will always have the correct leading whitespace to match. This might not hold true if the included file starts with empty lines or if the user wants to prepend something to an empty file.

The regular expression used to determine leading whitespace could be simplified to `r'^
*'` if the intention is to match only leading newlines, but since it matches all leading whitespace characters, it seems appropriate. However, a comment explaining the regex could improve readability.
